provenance.author: GPT Creative Direction
provenance.notes: Original visual-development data for the fictional Yugasumi Valley vertical slice. Japanese geothermal mountain landscapes inform material and atmosphere only; no real site is depicted.

tagline.ja: 湯けむりを背に負う、谷のゆるやかな山脈。
tagline.en: A slow-moving ridgeline carrying the valley's steam upon its back.

description.ja: 柱のような四肢と、肩から腰へ垂れる苔色の外套をもつ大型草食獣。群れは幼体を内側に置き、冬の夜には湯霞の泉へ静かな道を刻む。
description.en: A vast grazer on four columnar limbs, with a lichen-toned mantle falling from shoulder to hip. Herds keep calves inside their formation and wear patient paths to the spring on winter nights.

giant_grazer.silhouette: Thumbnail read: four near-vertical columns under a deep barrel, a high broken shoulder-mantle, small low-slung wedge head, and a short heavy counterweight tail. Never elephantine: no trunk, fan ears, or tusks.

behaviorExpression.greet: Anticipation: both slow and lower the horn line. Action: cheek and mantle edge press in a long nuzzle. Follow-through: shared exhale, then parallel stance.
behaviorExpression.groom: One presents a mantle flank; the partner rakes loose lichen with the blunt lower incisors, then both shake the skin in a slow ripple.
behaviorExpression.play: Calves plant the forefeet, swing the oversized head sideways, then bound with rear legs together; adults answer only with a measured shoulder feint.
behaviorExpression.court: The suitor walks a broad half-circle, showing horn span and mantle depth, then waits motionless for the other to close the distance.
behaviorExpression.nurse: The calf folds its long front legs and tucks beneath the adult barrel; the adult widens stance and curls the tail away from contact.
behaviorExpression.bathe: Tests the lip with one foot, descends weight-first, then lets the barrel settle until steam catches on the mantle; exit includes a full-body water roll.
behaviorExpression.graze: Forelegs remain planted while neck sweeps a deliberate arc; lips tear whole grass clumps and the jaw continues grinding during the next step.
behaviorExpression.vigilance: Chewing stops first, then head and short ears align; nearby adults copy the stillness in a delayed wave.
behaviorExpression.alarm: A chest resonance precedes the visible call; mantle lifts, head snaps high, and the nearest calf moves inward.
behaviorExpression.flee: Turns are weighty and staged through four planted feet; calves accelerate first while adults run as an outer moving wall.
behaviorExpression.defend: Adults step shoulder-to-shoulder, lower paired horns, stamp once, then advance only enough to deny the predator a line to the calves.
behaviorExpression.sleep: Knees fold in sequence; the barrel settles sternum-first, with one sentinel remaining upright and the mantle rising on deep breaths.

tagline.ja: 夕草を縫い、家族の匂いをたどる小さな探索者。
tagline.en: A small dusk-wanderer stitching paths through grass by scent and memory.

description.ja: 花弁形の耳と、枯れ薄に似た長い房尾をもつ雑食獣。薄明の家族群は鼻先の挨拶を重ね、幼体は倒木や互いの影まで遊び場に変える。
description.en: A social omnivore with petal-fold ears and a long tail like a dry reed plume. At twilight families renew scent greetings, while young turn roots, stones, and even one another's shadows into games.

kit_forager.silhouette: Thumbnail read: light arched body on springy digitigrade legs, two tall petal-fold ears, narrow muzzle, and an extravagant reed-plume tail carried above the back. Tail mass, not eye size, owns the read.

behaviorExpression.greet: Anticipation: tail lowers and ears open sideways. Action: three quick nose-to-cheek sniffs with a brief shoulder pass. Follow-through: tails cross, then lift.
behaviorExpression.groom: Forepaws brace on the partner's shoulder while incisors comb the tail base; the recipient closes one ear and leans into the pressure.
behaviorExpression.play: A freeze precedes each burst; juveniles side-hop, pounce through tail plumes, tumble, then spring apart and invite pursuit with forequarters low.
behaviorExpression.warn: Ears flatten into one narrow leaf shape, body rises on straight legs, and the plume tail lashes once before a dry bark.
behaviorExpression.court: Partners trace mirrored figure-eights, pausing nose-to-tail; acceptance is a synchronized tail lift and quiet flank contact.
behaviorExpression.nurse: Young knead with alternating forepaws; the parent curls the plume around the litter as a windbreak, then grooms each crown.
behaviorExpression.bathe: Wades only to belly depth, splashes the tail deliberately, and darts out to shake from nose to tail tip.
behaviorExpression.forage: Ears triangulate independently while the nose parts litter; discoveries are pinned with both forepaws before a quick testing bite.
behaviorExpression.vigilance: Rises onto hind toes with tail held horizontal as a family signal; one ear tracks home while the other tracks danger.
behaviorExpression.alarm: A single sharp bark freezes the family; the caller tail-flicks toward the den before following last.
behaviorExpression.flee: Three bounding strides, a broken-angle turn behind cover, then a low sprint with ears folded and tail streaming.
behaviorExpression.feed: Sits back on the haunches, rotates food between nimble forepaws, and pauses often to listen.
behaviorExpression.sleep: Family members coil nose-to-tail; juveniles disappear under adult plumes except for folded ear tips.

tagline.ja: 風下の陰に伏せ、谷の動きがほどける瞬間を待つ。
tagline.en: It lies in the downwind seam and waits for the valley's order to loosen.

description.ja: 低く長い胴、強い後肢、肩で割れる黒い鬣をもつ単独性の捕食者。狩りは忍耐に始まり、しばしば失敗に終わる。縄張りの境では争いよりも側面姿勢と尾の合図を選ぶ。
description.en: A solitary predator built low and long, with powerful hindquarters and a dark mane split over the shoulders. Its hunts begin in patience and often end empty; at borders it prefers broadside display and tail signals to injury.

ridge_stalker.silhouette: Thumbnail read: head, spine, and tail form one low horizontal stroke; oversized folded hindquarters sit above it, while a short split shoulder-mane makes a dark notch. No feline rosettes, saber teeth, or dragon spines.

behaviorExpression.greet: Rare and guarded: familiar adults approach on parallel tracks, exchange flank scent without face contact, then separate without turning backs.
behaviorExpression.groom: One deliberate lick along the split mane follows scent recognition; prolonged grooming is reserved for parent and young.
behaviorExpression.play: Young rehearse ambushes with exaggerated shoulder dips and inhibited paw contact, breaking off the instant the partner vocalizes.
behaviorExpression.warn: Anticipation: turns broadside at the boundary. Action: split mane rises, tail draws a rigid hook, lips part silently. Follow-through: three backward steps without surrendering eye line.
behaviorExpression.court: The male leaves a scrape, retreats downwind, and lowers the mane; the female controls every closing distance.
behaviorExpression.nurse: The mother lies with head uphill, scanning; young press beneath the rear ribcage and freeze whenever her tail tip stops.
behaviorExpression.vigilance: Only the eyes and small ears move; the tail tip counts wind shifts against the ground.
behaviorExpression.alarm: No loud call: a low chest pulse, exposed rust throat, and sudden mane flare carry the warning.
behaviorExpression.flee: Drops from view before accelerating, using two long bounds and a hard lateral cut into terrain shadow.
behaviorExpression.defend: Protecting young, it circles rather than charges, keeping the threat in front and the den behind its stronger hindquarters.
behaviorExpression.stalk: Shoulder blades alternate beneath a level spine; each forepaw tests the ground, belly nearly touches cover, and movement stops when prey looks up.
behaviorExpression.chase: Hindquarters release in two explosive bounds; tail straightens as a rudder, mouth stays closed until the final lunge.
behaviorExpression.feed: Pins with both forepaws, tears backward with the neck, then lifts its head to scan after every few bites.
behaviorExpression.sleep: Chooses a lee hollow, spine curved around the vulnerable belly, nose tucked under the split mane but ears exposed.

tagline.ja: 湯の上に見えない輪を描き、谷の死を空へ返す。
tagline.en: It draws invisible rings above the springs and returns the valley's dead to the sky.

description.ja: 一対の脚と二枚の長翼をもつ昼行性の腐肉食者。黒い指羽と淡い腹が、上空では墨の輪と白い芯に見える。岩棚から風を読み、湯の上昇気流をほとんど羽ばたかずに登る。
description.en: A day-active scavenger standing on one leg pair beneath two long wings. Dark fingered primaries and a pale belly form an ink ring around a white center overhead. It reads wind from the crag and climbs spring thermals with scarcely a wingbeat.

thermal_glider.silhouette: Thumbnail read: in flight, very broad shallow-M wings with seven separated ink-dark fingers, a small diamond tail, and a long S neck; perched, a tall one-pair biped wrapped in wings that cross below the tail.

behaviorExpression.greet: Both lower crests, sidestep along the perch, and preen one stroke at the partner's shoulder; acceptance ends in mirrored wing-folds.
behaviorExpression.groom: The beak zips each primary from base to tip; a full wing is offered only after the partner settles its crest.
behaviorExpression.play: Juveniles release twigs into the updraft, bank after them, and pull away just before capture; landing is noisy and deliberately overbalanced.
behaviorExpression.warn: Faces the intruder, fans the diamond tail, spreads only the dark primary fingers, and clacks the beak without leaving the perch.
behaviorExpression.court: A high spiral becomes a silent paired descent; the male rolls to show the pale belly and rust underwing bar before both return to the crag.
behaviorExpression.nurse: Parent braces tall over the nest, shades the chick with one half-open wing, and transfers small food pieces beak to beak.
behaviorExpression.vigilance: Perched body remains still while the S neck makes precise angular scans; one wing loosens when wind strengthens.
behaviorExpression.alarm: Crest and neck frill flatten, wings snap half-open, and a two-note cry sends nearby birds off the rock.
behaviorExpression.flee: Drops below the perch before opening the wings, trading height for immediate speed and banking behind the crag.
behaviorExpression.feed: Lands upwind, approaches in two-foot hops, opens wings as a privacy screen, and tears small pieces with backward head jerks.
behaviorExpression.soar: Enters the steam column with one deep wingbeat; primaries spread, tail makes tiny corrections, and the body traces widening circles.
behaviorExpression.glide: Neck retracts between the shoulders, wings lock in a shallow M, and one tip drops to turn without flapping.
behaviorExpression.perch: Feet reach together, wings flare against forward motion, then fold in two distinct layers while the tail remains fanned for balance.
behaviorExpression.sleep: Balances on one leg with the other drawn into belly feathers; head turns backward beneath the crossed wing tips.
